base_url.description: Umami's base URL, e.g. http://10.77.0.1:3001 (no trailing slash).

website_id.description: The Umami-internal website identifier. Found in the Umami UI's website settings page (its URL contains the website's id).

password.description: secret_ref to the Umami account password, resolved by the core before the adapter is spawned — never a plaintext value at rest.

lookback_seconds.description: How far back each poll's traffic-stats window looks. Longer than the infra adapters' default since a short window reads mostly zeros for a low-traffic site.

tracked_events.description: Optional list of Umami custom event names to track. For each name, one analytics.event_count metric is emitted per poll (labels: {event: <name>}), counting matching events within lookback_seconds. Fully generic — sre-kit has no built-in notion of which events matter; supply whatever event names your own site emits (e.g. a signup funnel's steps).
